data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. We're sorry to hear about the frustration with your assigned tickets not appearing correctly! To resolve this, please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, then log out and back into CloudDesk. This often resolves display issues related to permissions. If that doesn't immediately solve it, please ask an administrator to briefly reassign the ticket to someone else, save, and then reassign it back to you. This should help refresh your view. [T-2793] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
